title: Rolling upgrade without downtime
statement: The system shall upgrade one node at a time between consecutive minor versions while continuing to serve reads and writes, transferring shard leadership off each node before it stops.
rationale: Planned maintenance must not consume the availability budget.

acceptance_criteria.text: During a rolling upgrade under YCSB workload A, the synthetic probe records no failed interval and OLTP p99 stays within its target +50%.
A mixed-version cluster of N and N+1 minor versions passes the transaction test suite.
